mapper.insert: insert into pilipili.user_message(user_id, video_id, message_type, send_user_id, read_type, create_time, extend_json) values (#{userId}, #{videoId}, #{messageType}, #{sendUserId}, #{readType}, #{createTime}, #{extendJson})
mapper.select: SELECT message_type, COUNT(*) messageCount FROM pilipili.user_message where user_id = #{userId} and read_type = 0 GROUP BY message_type;
